terminal.CANCELLED: This contract was cancelled and is commercially read-only.
terminal.TERMINATED: This contract was terminated and is commercially read-only.

overview.terminalHint: Records remain available for reference and export. No further applications or certificates can be raised against it.
overview.notActiveHint: Billing begins once the contract is executed and active. Complete the contract to start the payment cycle.

NO_MAIN_CONTRACT.title: No main contract
NO_MAIN_CONTRACT.impact: Certification and billing cannot start until a client contract exists.

GUARANTEE_EXPIRING.title: Guarantee expiring soon
GUARANTEE_EXPIRING.impact: A guarantee will expire within the attention window and may need renewal.

GUARANTEE_EXPIRED.title: Guarantee expired
GUARANTEE_EXPIRED.impact: A guarantee has passed its expiry date and no longer provides cover.

UNINVOICED_CERTIFICATE.title: Certified work not invoiced
UNINVOICED_CERTIFICATE.impact: An effective certificate has no client invoice, so entitlement is not yet billed.

RECONCILIATION_FAILED.title: Figures could not be reconciled
RECONCILIATION_FAILED.impact: Part of the commercial position failed to load. Amounts shown may be incomplete.

mainContract.frozenHint: This contract is active, so its commercial baseline cannot be edited directly. Material changes require a Variation.
mainContract.title: Main contract
mainContract.termsLocked: Contract terms are locked while the contract is active.
mainContract.clientLockedHint: The client name and tax details were frozen onto this contract when it was executed. Editing the client record will not change them.
mainContract.willLockHint: The client name and tax details will be frozen onto this contract when it is executed.

retention.title: Retention
retention.releaseTerms: {pc} at practical completion, {fc} at final completion
retention.notApplicable: This contract is billed from a payment schedule, which deducts no retention.

retentionAdvances.readFirstNote: Contractual terms only. Held, released and recovered balances are calculated by a future release and are not shown here yet.
retentionAdvances.title: Retention & advances

guarantees.emptyHint: No performance bonds or guarantees have been recorded for this contract.
guarantees.title: Guarantees

applications.title: Applications & Certification
applications.subtitle: Prepare, review and certify interim payment applications.
applications.emptyHint: No interim payment applications have been raised against this contract.
applications.hiddenTitle: This contract has no application workflow
applications.hiddenHint: It is billed from a negotiated payment schedule, so there are no interim payment applications or certificates. Billing happens on the payment plan.

contractSecurity.title: Contract & Security
contractSecurity.subtitle: The commercial baseline, contractual terms and instruments that protect performance.

billing.title: Billing & Collection
billing.subtitle: Posted client invoices, receipt allocations and the outstanding accounting balance.
billing.emptyHint: Certified work will appear here after a client invoice is generated.
billing.readyTitle: Certified work is ready to invoice
billing.readyHint: Generate the client invoice from the effective certificate before collection can begin.
billing.noContractHint: Billing runs against the main contract. Create and execute a contract first.
billing.loadFailed: Could not load the billing position
billing.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading invoices and receipts. Try again.
billing.basisNote: Measured against invoice totals, VAT included.
billing.noInvoices: No client invoices have been raised against this contract yet.
billing.noReceipts: No client payments have been allocated to this contract yet.
billing.receiptsNote: Receipts are shown with the allocations that settle this contract's invoices.
billing.unappliedHint: Client-level, not project-level: this cash has not been attributed to any contract yet.
billing.vatNote: Totals are VAT-inclusive. Settlement is measured against the invoice total, never against a pre-VAT certified amount.

paymentSchedule.title: Payment schedule
paymentSchedule.subtitle: Milestone contract. Each installment is billed from its own invoice as the schedule advances.
paymentSchedule.emptyHint: This milestone contract has no installments yet.

generateDialog.title: Generate invoice — {name}
generateDialog.hint: Raise a client invoice for this installment. It is created as a draft and numbered when posted.

milestone.ungatedAdvance: Paid on mobilization — no milestone required
milestone.blockedHint: The linked milestone must be verified before this installment can be invoiced.
milestone.dialogHint: Billing this installment will be blocked until the linked milestone is verified (CONST-COM-011).
milestone.noMilestones: No programme milestones exist yet. Create one in Programme & Progress first.
milestone.failed: Could not update the milestone link

paymentScheduleTab.title: Payment schedule
paymentScheduleTab.subtitle: This contract is billed from a negotiated milestone schedule. Each stage is invoiced from its own document as the schedule advances.
paymentScheduleTab.draftHint: The contract is still a draft, so the whole schedule can be re-profiled. Percentages must total 100%.
paymentScheduleTab.reprofileNote: This contract is committed, so its schedule is fixed. Re-profile a committed schedule through a Variation.
paymentScheduleTab.noPermission: You do not have permission to edit this contract's payment schedule.
paymentScheduleTab.notReconciled: The plan does not total 100% — the contract cannot be billed in full until it does.
paymentScheduleTab.saveFailed: Could not save the payment schedule.

milestone.allBilledHint: All {total} installments have been billed. Collection is tracked in Billing & Collection.

certification.title: Certification position
certification.unavailable: Certification figures could not be loaded.

receivables.title: Receivables position
receivables.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}

variations.title: Variations
variations.subtitle: Raise, approve and track changes to the contract scope and value
variations.noContractHint: Variations are raised against the project's main contract. Add and execute a contract first.
variations.emptyHint: Raise a variation to propose a change in scope or value. The contract value moves only once a variation is client-approved.
variations.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading the variations. Try again.

contractValue.rule: Contract value changes only when a variation is client-approved. Pending variations are shown for information and are never added into the governing value.

create.title: Raise a variation
create.subtitle: Draft a change to the contract. Add line items — additions and omissions — then save as a draft.
create.timeImpactHint: Proposed only. It never moves the completion date on its own — record an extension of time for that.
create.netPreviewHint: A preview only. The saved variation shows the value derived by the server.

detail.subtitle: Variation order
detail.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading it. Try again.
detail.noLines: No line items on this variation.
detail.clientRefHint: The signed variation number or client letter reference.

toast.internalApproveFailed: Could not internally approve the variation

trace.title: Certified & invoiced by variation
trace.explainer: Where certified and invoiced value to date traces back to — the original scope and each variation. The rows reconcile to the total.
trace.exVatNote: Figures are gross of VAT and certificate deductions (ex-VAT). They are not the invoice or VAT-inclusive total.
trace.loadFailed: Could not load the certified & invoiced trace
trace.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading it. Try again.

atRisk.title: At-risk commencement
atRisk.explainer: An audited authorisation to start urgent work before the variation is client-approved. It changes neither the contract value nor the BOQ — it is an exception, not the normal path.
atRisk.none: No at-risk commencement recorded on this variation.
atRisk.formWarning: This records an exception, not the normal approval path. It changes neither the contract value nor the BOQ.
atRisk.exposureHint: The value ACCO accepts by starting early, in the contract currency.
atRisk.ceoHint: Leave empty unless the exposure exceeds the cap. The server decides whether the CEO is required and rejects a mismatch.

toast.recordFailed: Could not record the at-risk commencement

eot.title: Extension of time
eot.explainer: Moving the completion date is an explicit, recorded act. A variation's proposed time impact is justification you may cite — it is never applied automatically.
eot.emptyHint: The completion date has not been moved. Record an extension of time to change it.
eot.loadFailed: Could not load the extension history.
eot.grantSubtitle: Move the contract completion date. This is an explicit, audited change.
eot.citeHint: Reference variations as justification. Citing a variation does not apply its proposed time impact — this act sets the date.
eot.noVariations: No variations on this contract to cite.

toast.grantFailed: Could not record the extension of time

paymentPlan.title: Payment plan
paymentPlan.empty: This contract has no payment installments yet.
paymentPlan.notReconciled: The plan does not total 100% — the contract cannot be billed in full until it does.
paymentPlan.originalBasis: Shares are of the original contract value. Approved variations change the contract value but not this plan.

paymentTerms.title: Payment terms
paymentTerms.measuredHint: This contract is billed from certified progress. There is no negotiated installment plan — each interim certificate becomes an invoice.
paymentTerms.empty: No payment installments have been agreed yet.
paymentTerms.amendmentHint: Changing an agreed installment requires a contract amendment.

contractStatus_.title: Contract status
contractStatus_.noneRequired: No further action required at this stage
contractStatus_.exited: This contract is {status} and has left the normal lifecycle.
